program.title: BSc in Physics
uncertain: total_required_credits (57.0) is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all non-optional groups (core required + pre-requisites + the 3-credit Physics Elective), using the lower bound for credit ranges (e.g. 3-4, 4-6).

The program has Tracks/Options (Computational Physics with AI, Honors Physics, Physics and Mathematics, International Research Enrichment). These are optional and excluded from total_required_credits; the core total (57) applies to a student not taking any track.
Several MATH/PHYS choice blocks restrict which option satisfies them (e.g. only PHYS 1312 for IRE pre-requisite); these constraints affect actual credits taken but the lower bound is used here.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 PHYS (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the 2026-27 intake curriculum.
